newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 10.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:

- The U.S. Energy Department said it would try to dispose of plutonium from old nuclear weapons, by using it in fuel in utilities' reactors and by solidifying it with nuclear waste created when the plutonium was made.

- The scientist who led a 1994 Pentagon study that discounted links between chemical weapons and illnesses reported by Persian Gulf veterans said some of the findings might have to be revised in light of new evidence.
- New York Assembly Speaker Sheldon Silver said he wanted to toughen penalties against many juvenile criminals and make it easier for school officials to suspend students caught carrying guns.
- Top U.S. medical centres are helping to fill their beds and pay their bills by wooing foreign patients.
